registers.name: Control Register (BMCR)
registers.desc: Reset (bit15, self-clearing), Loopback (bit14), Speed Selection, Auto-Negotiation Enable (bit12), Power Down (bit11), Isolate, Restart Auto-Neg (bit9), Duplex Mode (bit8)

registers.name: Status Register (BMSR)
registers.desc: Link Status (bit2), Auto-Negotiation Complete (bit5), Remote Fault, capability bits

registers.name: PHY Identifier 1
registers.desc: OUI bits 3:18 of the Organizationally Unique Identifier

registers.name: PHY Identifier 2
registers.desc: OUI low bits, model number, revision number

registers.name: Auto-Negotiation Link Partner Ability
registers.desc: Abilities received from the link partner
